senses: supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province
lex:
ἀνθύπατος -ου, ὁ
(ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος),
supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province (cf. ἡγεμών, and see MM, VGT, 44): Act.13:7-8, 12 18:12 19:38.†

strongs.def: instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul
strongs.from: from G473 (ἀντί) and a superlative of G5228 (ὑπέρ)
